payload.title: DevTools event feed + inspect devtools/analytics/platform-events routes (FR-249 finish)
payload.description: inspect.rs stubs /_frick/inspect/{devtools/events,devtools/summary,analytics/summary,platform-events} as not-available. Port store.devtoolsEvents (durable feed) + the analytics summary + the inspect routes. This also unblocks diagnostics.rs recentErrors (currently empty array) and the idempotency-cache stats (currently defaults) — add the FrickStore facade getters those need.
